thread:
maria (PM): Quick sync — need a mapped dependency plan for Q2 initiatives. Focus: Dedicated autoscale, Private deploy v1, Optimize suggestions. Can owners pls call out blockers, hard deps, and a realistic milestone sequence? Goal: finalize critical path by EOD Fri.
kevin (eng-platform): I can own Dedicated autoscale. Main blocker: autoscaler infra work + GPU pool migration. Need SRE signoff and infra tickets merged.
samir (eng-ml): On Optimize suggestions — we need eval harness + small A/B on quantized models. Blocker: model quantization validation and latency regression checks. ETA depends on infra batch API.
olivia (eng-sre): SRE acceptance window: we need a staging perf run and an incident playbook. Can do signoff 2 wks after infra PRs land. Also need capacity reservations for Dedicated smoke tests. :+1:
nora (design): UX for Private deploy onboarding has two screens and one consent flow. I can deliver mocks in 5 business days if product spec is stable. Blocker: API surface for tenancy config (kevin).
maria (PM): Proposed sequence (rough): 1) infra changes + capacity (kevin) 2) staging perf + SRE runbook (olivia) 3) model validation + opt A/B (samir) 4) UX + docs (nora) 5) canary rollout. Does that match team constraints?
kevin (eng-platform): sequence looks good. Small tweak: lock Private deploy APIs before infra change to avoid rework. Also need infra ETA: 3 weeks for autoscaler + migration unless we pull in extra pair.
samir (eng-ml): If we parallelize eval harness with infra (depends on mocked API), we can shave 1 week. I can start on harness against a stub.
maria (PM): Owners and rough dates please (format: feature - owner - blocker - target date). I'll collate into the milestone board.
kevin (eng-platform): Dedicated autoscale - kevin - autoscaler infra + GPU pool migration - target 2026-05-15
samir (eng-ml): Optimize suggestions (eval + A/B) - samir - quant validation + latency regressions - target 2026-05-22
olivia (eng-sre): Staging perf + runbook - olivia - infra PRs merged + capacity reservation - target 2026-05-29
nora (design): Private deploy onboarding screens - nora - API spec finalization - target 2026-05-08
maria (PM): Good. Critical path appears to be: kevin infra -> olivia staging -> samir validation. If infra slips, whole rollout shifts. Can we add a fallback: degrade autoscale to static pools if autoscaler delayed?
kevin (eng-platform): Yes we can ship with static pools as fallback. That reduces autoscaler scope (cut 2 weeks) but increases ops cost. Decision: ship fallback or hold full autoscaler. Call for trade-off: @maria @cto.
maria (PM): I'll raise trade-off in exec sync tomorrow. Meanwhile, everyone add exact PR links and task IDs to the milestone card. I'll update the board before EOD Fri.
deploy-bot: CI status — infra/autoscaler pipeline: 2 failing builds, failing on gpu-scheduler-test. @kevin
kevin (eng-platform): I'll triage the failing tests today.
maria (PM): Thanks — tagging action items: 1) kevin: PR triage + estimate update by EOD Tue. 2) samir: start eval harness against stub by Wed. 3) olivia: draft runbook template by Thu. 4) nora: deliver mocks v1 by Thu. Everyone: add task IDs to milestone card. :eyes:
